name: Live Transcribe
description: A focused, minimal front-end for the audio-transcribe Live mode: one big button to start talking and watch the transcript appear and refine, with the live cost shown. Or drop an audio file to transcribe it. A 'max-simplicity' experience variation that reuses the audio-transcribe JS API and components.

api.note: A minimal variation of audio-transcribe focused on Live mode. Reuses audio-transcribe's api/ modules (state, transport, transcribe pipeline, live session) and the ui-live panel; no Queue/Bundle/Send/Voice/Chat. The OpenRouter key is shared with audio-transcribe (localStorage 'sg-openrouter-mgmt-key', BYOK). Live re-sends the growing take per segment (each a real billed request) — cost shown per segment + a running total.

connect.description: Announce the OpenRouter key for the isolated transport. Params {apiKey, model?}.

setApiKey.description: Persist + connect the OpenRouter key (localStorage 'sg-openrouter-mgmt-key'). Params {apiKey, model?}. Returns {ok, present}.

startLive.description: Open the mic and transcribe the growing take every ~2.5s. Emits at:live:started then at:live:update / at:live:segment. In a sandboxed frame without mic access, rejects { code: 'mic-unavailable' } + emits at:live:error.

stopLive.description: Final pass, then save the take (with transcript). Emits at:item:added + at:live:stopped. Returns {id, text, durationMs}.

addFiles.description: Drop/ingest audio files as items. Params {files}. Emits at:item:added per file.

transcribeAll.description: Transcribe every queued/error item in parallel. Emits at:batch:started/progress/complete.

getItem.description: One serialisable item by {id}, or null.

getCostSummary.description: Session cost roll-up {sessionUsd, sessionPending, perItem, auxUsd, auxPending}.
